source_identity.scope: Consumer runtime and packaged data, web source/tests/public assets, Python package metadata and web build/runner inputs; excludes docs, outputs and bytecode.
source_identity.bar_completion_check: All 97 captured file hashes matched immediately after the final 60-execution run. No browser-facing source or dataset changes occurred during that run.
source_identity.subsequent_backend_validation: After local browser completion, the parent tightened the research importer to require exact Gold schema/integer scores, bounded quarantine evidence, known prior archives for 304 and monotonic poll clocks. The parent reported 17 targeted Python tests and Ruff passing. The local 19 + 60 browser executions used the earlier accepted importer; final container verification and remote CI are separate evidence.

asserted_workflows: All nine source editions and aggregate 2727/1088/1639 counts; observed-result default and explicit all/unknown selection.
Region, edition, text and source-calendar-date filters applied before exact 25-row pagination; empty result state and reset.
Historical unknown result remains unavailable and date-only; actual 0-0 remains an observed result; local 18:30 clock does not claim a UTC instant.
Source FT 1-1, HT 1-0 and penalties 4-3 remain distinct; retrospective research records expose no stored forecast.
Source URL, CC0 license, checksum, dataset identity, derived team identity caveat and observation revision evidence in inspectable native drawers.
Deep-linked match reload, browser back/forward, clipboard link with status, Escape close and focus return, edition navigation and return to original synthetic Match center.
Public desktop/mobile packages make no /api requests; mobile filters remain operable and no horizontal document overflow is observed.
All 13 previous sports, point-in-time match/competition/team, forecast, evidence chat, feedback, unavailable-model and static restriction cases pass in the 19-case full regression.

limitations: Chromium desktop and Chromium Pixel 7 emulation only; no Firefox, WebKit, physical device or screen-reader certification.
This checks browser integration and deterministic evidence workflows, not native model semantic quality.
Community open-data imports can be incomplete or stale. Source dates/local clocks have no inferred UTC kickoff/completion; collection times do not establish historical pre-match availability.
OpenFootball records remain a separate research contract with unresolved name-derived team IDs, no official standings and no prediction eligibility.
A prior development-server termination remains unexplained; its complete failing run artifacts were retained and later full/stability runs passed with stdout instrumentation.
Raw JSON reports, detailed fingerprints, logs and failure traces are retained under ignored web/test-results in this workspace; published JSON summarizes actual measurements and hashes.
